title: Before the Rounds
html:
Ellis Pike has two deliveries to plan and no idea whether either workshop is open.

About

Given byEllis Pike
Level1
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Ellis Pike (outdoors near Binxonia) to get the quest.
  2. Ask the Mining Trainer in Binxonia about deliveries.
  3. Ask the Lumberjack Trainer about deliveries.
  4. Report the workshop orders to Ellis Pike to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold15
Character XP200
Quest points1

What Ellis Pike says

Mining Trainer: Tell Ellis I need ore brought in on his next round. The Lumberjack Trainer has another order for him. Speak to him before you head back.

Lumberjack Trainer: I've got timber waiting for Ellis. Tell him he can collect it on his next round. That should be both our orders.

Ellis Pike: Ore and timber. Same as yesterday, then. Here's your pay. At least I can get started now.

Handing it in

"Ore and timber. Same as yesterday, then. Here's your pay. At least I can get started now."
